**EIPIP Meeting 83**
Date and Time: June 14, 2023 at 14:00 UTC
Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/241

excerpts.author: samwilsn
excerpts.content:
- External Links
    - Allow links to: BIPs, W3C, IETF, WHATWG.
  - Undecided on yellow paper
- Define "EVM Equivalence" (PR #6269)
    - Staying closed. The EIPs repository cannot enforce a definition on layer 2 marketing teams.
- Renaming "Security Considerations" to "Security & Privacy"
    - Still has objections. Put privacy into security considerations.
- Splitting the repository.
    - No consensus.
